_info: Mooxy AI — Phone Model Database for Repair Diagnostics

edl_test_points._description: EDL mode test point locations for Qualcomm devices. Short the test point to GND while connecting USB cable (phone OFF).

oneplus.OnePlus 9R: Near SoC area on motherboard. Remove back cover → locate TP pad near main processor → short to ground with tweezer while plugging USB. Phone must be OFF.
oneplus.OnePlus 9: Near SoC, similar location to 9R. Test point under EMI shield near CPU.
oneplus.OnePlus 9 Pro: Near SoC, under EMI shield can B.
oneplus.OnePlus 8: Near SoC area, under main shield.
oneplus.OnePlus Nord: Near SoC on back of motherboard.

xiaomi.general: Most Xiaomi Qualcomm devices: TP near SoC or eMMC/UFS. Check specific model on XDA/GSM forum.
xiaomi.Redmi Note 10 Pro: Near UFS chip, test point pad visible after removing back cover and shields.
xiaomi.POCO F3: Near SoC area under EMI shield.

samsung.general: Samsung Qualcomm variants: TP usually near CPU under EMI shield. Samsung Exynos devices do NOT have Qualcomm EDL mode — use Odin/Download mode instead.
samsung.download_mode_key: Volume Down + Power (with USB cable connected)

realme_oppo.general: Realme/OPPO Qualcomm devices: TP near SoC. MediaTek devices use MTK bypass (BROM) instead of EDL.
realme_oppo.mtk_brom_mode: For MediaTek devices: Short boot pin to GND during power on. Tool: SP Flash Tool or MTK Auth Bypass.
realme_oppo.Realme GT 2 Pro: Qualcomm SM8450. TP near SoC under EMI shield, accessible after removing back panel and mid-frame shield.
realme_oppo.OPPO Find X5 Pro: Qualcomm SM8450. TP pad near CPU area under main EMI shield.
realme_oppo.OPPO Reno 10 Pro+: Qualcomm SM8475. TP near SoC, remove back cover and EMI can.

vivo.general: Vivo Qualcomm devices: TP near SoC area. Most Vivo phones use MediaTek, so use SP Flash Tool / MTK BROM bypass instead.
vivo.mtk_brom_mode: For MediaTek Vivo devices: Short boot pin to GND during power on. Use SP Flash Tool with MTK Auth Bypass.
vivo.Vivo X80 Pro: Qualcomm SM8450. TP near SoC under EMI shield. Remove back panel and shields to access.
vivo.Vivo T1: Qualcomm SM7325. TP near SoC area, accessible after removing back cover.

motorola.general: Motorola Qualcomm devices: TP near SoC. Many Moto G series use test point near CPU under EMI shield. Motorola also supports bootloader unlock via official site.
motorola.Motorola Edge 50 Pro: Qualcomm SM8475. TP near SoC under EMI shield. Remove back panel to access.
motorola.Motorola Edge 40 Pro: Qualcomm SM8550. TP near SoC area under main shield.
motorola.Moto G34: Qualcomm SM6225. TP near SoC, accessible after removing back panel and shields.
motorola.Moto G84: Qualcomm SM6225. TP near SoC area. Remove back cover and locate pad near processor.

samsung.frp_bypass_notes: Samsung FRP requires Samsung account or Google account. Knox may prevent bypass on newer devices.

xiaomi.frp_bypass_notes: Xiaomi has Mi Account lock in addition to Google FRP. Both need to be removed.

oneplus.recovery_key: Volume Down + Power (release at logo, keep Vol Down)
oneplus.frp_bypass_notes: OnePlus allows bootloader unlock via developer options. MSM Tool flashes full firmware and removes all locks.

realme_oppo.flash_tool: MSM Download Tool (Qualcomm) / SP Flash Tool (MTK)
realme_oppo.frp_bypass_notes: ColorOS FRP can be bypassed via fastboot or EDL flash.

vivo.frp_bypass_notes: Vivo/iQOO FRP requires full firmware flash in most cases.

motorola.frp_bypass_notes: Motorola allows bootloader unlock via official website.

google.frp_bypass_notes: Pixel FRP requires original Google account. Factory image flash via fastboot removes FRP.

nothing.frp_bypass_notes: Nothing allows bootloader unlock via developer options. Fastboot flash removes locks.

repair_difficulty_guide.easy: Screen replacement, battery swap, charging port change, speaker/mic replacement
repair_difficulty_guide.medium: Charging IC replacement, backlight IC repair, FPC connector replacement, basic reball
repair_difficulty_guide.hard: CPU/SoC reball, WiFi/BT IC replacement, RF IC repair, modem reball
repair_difficulty_guide.expert: DRAM voltage regulator (fan53526/MT6691ZXP), NAND/UFS reball, baseband repair, board-level micro-soldering
